info.name: Plex Media Server Ultra Blur API

params.name: url
params.description: Url for image which requires color extraction. Can be relative PMS library path or absolute url.

items.docs: Retrieves the four colors extracted from an image for clients to use to generate an ultrablur image.

params.name: topLeft
params.description: The base color (hex) for the top left quadrant.

params.name: topRight
params.description: The base color (hex) for the top right quadrant.

params.name: bottomRight
params.description: The base color (hex) for the bottom right quadrant.

params.name: bottomLeft
params.description: The base color (hex) for the bottom left quadrant.

params.name: width
params.description: Width in pixels for the image.

params.name: height
params.description: Height in pixels for the image.

params.name: noise
params.description: Whether to add noise to the ouput image. Noise can reduce color banding with the gradients. Image sizes with noise will be larger.

items.docs: Retrieves a server-side generated UltraBlur image based on the provided color inputs. Clients should always call this via the photo transcoder endpoint.
